ETCSL 5.5.4 — The song of the hoe

  • Editors: ETCSL project (J. Black, G. Cunningham, E. Robson, G. Zólyomi et al.), Oxford 1998–2006.
  • URLs: transliteration https://etcsl.orinst.ox.ac.uk/cgi-bin/etcsl.cgi?text=c.5.5.4&display=Crit&charenc=gcirc ; translation https://etcsl.orinst.ox.ac.uk/cgi-bin/etcsl.cgi?text=t.5.5.4 ; ORACC: https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/epsd2/literary/Q000778 (lemmatised copy with morph in ../../ORACC/epsd2-literary--Q000778--*/)
  • Retrieved: 2026-10-16. The XML was copied from the local OTA 2518 bulk corpus (../_bulk/etcsl-unzipped/etcsl/); the live site and the Wayback HTML displays were not fetched this time (the XML is authoritative).
  • Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (OTA deposit); © ETCSL project, University of Oxford. Committed.

Content

Enlil separates heaven from earth "to make the seed of the land come up from the earth" (1–7); at Uzumua ("where flesh grew") he puts the first humans' heads into the brick mould and they break through the earth (8–20); the Anuna praise the hoe; the hoe's deeds in building, agriculture and burial, a long chain of puns on al "hoe" (21–110).

Files

  • c.5.5.4.xml, t.5.5.4.xml — ETCSL TEI source (2006 revised edition; lemmatised <w form lemma pos label>).
  • transliteration.md (110 composite lines), translation.md — clean UTF-8 conversions by ../../../tools/etcsl2md.py.

Manuscripts

Composite from 88 OB manuscripts (the best-attested text in this project); one damaged line.

Line numbering

ETCSL composite line numbers (110 lines). Translation paragraphs carry the line range they cover. Lines that only some manuscripts have are numbered with letters (e.g. 9A) or given as variants in parentheses.

ETCSL bibliography (from the XML header)

  • Kramer 1944 51-53; Farber 1997 (COS 1.157); Wilcke 1972 36-38; Civil 1969 70; Jacobsen 1946 134; Pettinato 1971 82-85; Civil 1994 (ll. 79, 85); Farber 1999, 2001.

Usefulness

Base text (rank 1) for the project סיפורי-הבריאה-המסופוטמיים/2-טקסטי-בריאה-ועדן/. ETCSL's prose translation is rank 3 (check only, after drafting).
